properties.statement: F5 in the reporter's words: 'None of that is a Requirement, a Constraint or a Decision… add_environment_rule looked right by name but is explicitly for rules that cannot be negotiated'. SEARCHED: dec:idea-where-does-a-disk-space-rule-live-when-the-gate-runs-on-the-wrong-machine (OPEN) is the same shape on this project. MEASURED: add_design_rule's `category` is free text ('a free-text grouping; the schema does not fix the set'); schema/structure.yaml declares GOVERNED_BY from `*` to [Decision, DesignRule, Requirement], so env:droplet GOVERNED_BY rule:droplet-runbook is legal today; capture-intent line 57 still says '⚠️ Nothing fits cleanly'. The reporter followed the table, and the table is wrong.
